root_idea.summary: A root oriented toward illumination and opening: the rising or shining of the sun, eastern direction, and the opening or splitting of an object.
root_idea.development: The central meanings develop into sunrise, brightness, eastern orientation, and exposure to sunlight. Other lexical branches extend toward saturation or obstruction, redness, splitting, and sun-drying.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Feminine inflection of the same eastern adjective.
Dictionary noun for the east, sunrise direction, and its dual and plural uses.
Plural active participle normalized to the singular participial citation form.

senses.definition: To become bright or shine with light.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the earth becomes bright with the light of its Lord; the verb is intransitive.

senses.definition: Eastern; of or pertaining to the east or place of sunrise.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally for something situated toward, associated with, or receiving light from the east.

senses.definition: Sunrise; the time when the sun rises and begins to shine.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression, it denotes a time of day.

senses.definition: The east; the place, quarter, or direction of sunrise.
senses.usage_conditions: The singular denotes the eastern direction or the place from which the sun rises.

senses.definition: The two sunrise points, especially those of summer and winter; by extension in a Quranic dual construction, the east and the west.
senses.usage_conditions: The dual may refer to the seasonal sunrise points or to the paired places of sunrise and sunset, according to context.

senses.definition: The various points or places of sunrise; the risings or eastern parts.
senses.usage_conditions: The plural may reflect the changing sunrise point across days or seasons and can denote multiple eastern regions or risings.
The Quranic form is a plural active participle used in a temporal construction meaning that an action occurred at sunrise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sun, moon, or stars rose; the sun shone and spread its light over the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I intransitive verb of rising or shining, distinct from the Quranic Form IV usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The palm trees showed redness or the colors of their dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of fruit or date palms as they develop visible color.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To slit the ear of a sheep or goat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The slitting is performed in the manner described under شَرْقَاء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pluck or cut fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I use referring to harvesting fruit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become choked with spittle, water, or something similar.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or other animate subject with the obstructing substance expressed by بِـ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become filled, obstructed, or saturated with something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical extension applies to a wound filled with blood, a place crowded by its occupants, a body saturated with perfume, or cloth saturated with dye.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become red or have blood visibly suffuse it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an eye, complexion, or other thing becoming red; the evidence also connects the use with intense redness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become mixed, commingled, or blended.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of becoming filled or intermingled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sun became dim, reddish, or close to setting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct usage describing the late-day sun, including the time when its light weakens or it becomes yellow or red.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go toward the east, take the eastern direction, or direct oneself eastward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II motion verb; the destination or orientation is the east or place of sunrise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pray at sunrise, and consequently to perform the festival-of-sacrifice prayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional ritual use associated with prayer after sunrise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The land became parched and dry from sun and lack of water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of land affected by drought or not reached by water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Being beautiful, sunny, or shining in the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal or verbal-noun use describing brightness and beauty of appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut meat into strips or pieces and expose it to the sun to dry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of throwing barley into a sunny place to dry or exposing an animal’s back so dew will dry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The three days following the day of sacrifice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional name explained in connection with drying sacrificial meat in the sun, the sacrifice after sunrise, or the prayer that follows the sacrifice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dye cloth yellow, red, or with saffron, including to saturate it thoroughly with dye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence distinguishes saffron dyeing from dyeing with safflower.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To plaster a watering-trough or tank with شَارُوق or صَارُوج.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction use, with the plastering material named in the expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The face or complexion shone and became bright with beauty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV intransitive use applied to the face or color.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause something to shine or make the world bright.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported and disputed transitive usage regarded in the evidence as post-classical or lacking decisive proof.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter upon the time of sunrise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV temporal use comparable to entering morning or the time of daylight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause an enemy to choke; figuratively, to impede someone’s speech or action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The causative construction takes a person as the affected object; the figurative use describes preventing someone from saying or doing something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To saturate or thoroughly dye a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use with the dye expressed by بِـ or فِي.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sit in a sunny place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is especially associated in some reports with sitting in the sun during winter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look through a door’s sunlit chink, the opening into which the rising sun’s light falls.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural construction involving a door or its fissure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The bow split.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VII intransitive use describing the bow’s breaking or separation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become drowned or immersed in tears.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an eye or person overwhelmed by tears.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sun, especially the rising sun, or the sun’s upper limb as it begins to rise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can denote the rising celestial body or its visible upper edge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where the sun shines, the warmth of the sun, or a sunny place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for a sunlit location or the warmth produced by sunlight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The light entering through the chink of a door.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for the beam or remnant of light visible through a narrow opening.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chink or fissure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for a narrow opening, including the chink of the mouth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bird of prey between a kite and a hawk or falcon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological noun with the plural شُرُوق.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something such as spittle obstructing or choking the throat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting the obstructing substance or condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place made bright by the sun’s shining upon it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive noun or adjective for a sun-brightened place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person choked with spittle, water, or the like.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived descriptive form names the person affected by choking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant or herbage flourishing, fresh, or juicy because of plentiful irrigation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended descriptive use, synonymous with being well-watered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Red, intensely red, or saturated with red dye or blood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to dyed cloth, lean red meat, a blood-colored object, or something of beautiful intense redness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mixed, commingled, or blended.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended descriptive use associated with intermixture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anxiety, grief, or anguish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare dialectal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A brand used to mark a sheep or goat with a slit ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized livestock term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sheep or goat whose ear has been slit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources describe several forms of slitting, including lengthwise slitting without complete separation and slitting into two or three parts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain red dye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun sense distinct from the adjective meaning eastern.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A handsome or beautiful boy or young man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive personal noun focused on beauty of face.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman with a small vulva, or whose vagina and rectum have become joined by tearing of the intervening separation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical term with the alternatives explicitly reported in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a particular idol.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name use from pre-Islamic religious vocabulary.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first part of the rising sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A diminutive noun for the initial visible portion of sunrise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land not reached by water or inundation and consequently parched by the sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal Egyptian term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side of a hill or mountain nearest the east; the eastern side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical noun contrasted with the western side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a disputed traditional expression, trials, conflicts, or factions rising from the east and likened to portions of a dark night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This interpretation is explicitly reported as an alternative transmission or attribution, not as the ordinary geographical sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a particular idol.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name use from the pre-Islamic period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plastering material equivalent to صَارُوج or lime plaster.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for plastering structures or watering-troughs; one related citation is qualified as possibly a transcription issue.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a disputed interpretation of a cited phrase, strips of meat cut and spread in the sun to dry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an attributed interpretation of a poetic expression, distinct from the ordinary plural of مَشْرِق for sunrise points.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bright from the sun’s shining.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive participial use for a place or thing made bright by sunlight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of sitting in the sun or a place upon which the sun shines.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Some usage restricts the reference particularly to a sunny place used in winter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person of the east; eastern or oriental.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied specifically to a person in the cited lexical description, distinct from the adjective شَرْقِيّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of prayer, especially the festival prayer-ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can denote the prayer place generally, the place of the two festivals, the festival ground at Mecca, or the mosque of al-Khayf.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The festival itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional shortening based on the festival prayer occurring after sunrise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Meat cut into strips and spread in the sun to dry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized passive-participial noun derived from the sun-drying process.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment or piece of cloth dyed yellow, saffron-colored, or red.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The color and method vary in the reported lexical descriptions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fortress, watering-trough, or tank plastered with شَارُوق.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use referring to a structure treated with the named plaster.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One going toward the east or place of sunrise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participle used substantivally and contrasted with one going west.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man accustomed to make his enemy choke with spittle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun describing a habitual or characteristic action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A door chink into which the light of the rising sun falls.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized architectural noun for a sunlit opening.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a gate for repentance in Heaven.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name or religious-cultural use reported in traditional vocabulary.

cautions: مَشْرِقَيْنِ may denote the two seasonal sunrise points or the paired east and west; the surrounding construction determines the intended relation.

Several rare Classical branches are reported with qualifications such as disputed attribution, dialectal restriction, or alternative interpretation; those qualifications are retained in their usage conditions.
